content: De Chullun ob God

Look yah! We oughta study pon how de Fada da bless we wid e lob! E da lob we sommuch dat e call we e own chullun, an we e chullun fa true. People ob de wol ain been know who God da, an cause ob dat, dey ain know we.
Me deah fren, we God chullun now. We ain know yet wa we gwine be bye an bye. Bot we know, wen Christ come back, we gwine be like um. Cause wen e come, we gwine shim jes like e da.
Ebrybody wa da set e haat like dis pon Christ, dat one gwine keep da lib clean, same like Christ lib a clean life.
Ebrybody wa keep on da sin ain da do wa God Law say e mus do. Wen we da sin, we da broke God Law.
Oona know Christ come fa tek way sin, an Christ ain hab no sin een e life.
De one wa da lib een Christ ain gwine keep on da sin. An de one wa da sin ain neba know Christ. E ain neba shim.
Me deah chullun, mus dohn leh nobody git oona fa stop folla de true way. De one wa da lib fa do de right ting, dat de one wa right een God eye, jes like Christ right.
Ebrybody wa keep on da sin blongst ta de Debil. Cause de Debil beena sin fom de fus. Dat wa mek God Son come. E come fa stroy de wok dem ob de Debil.
De one wa God chile ain gwine jes keep on da sin, cause e hab God een e haat. An cause God e Fada, e ain able fa sin.

God chullun an de Debil chullun, dey diffunt fom one noda. De one wa da sin ain da do wa right, e ain God own chile. An de one wa ain lob e broda ain God chile needa. Dat de way we know de one wa God own chile, an de one wa blongst ta de Debil.
Mus Lob One Noda fa True
Dis de message oona done yeh fom de fus: We mus lob one noda.
We mus dohn be like Cain, wa blongst ta dat ebil one, de Debil. Cain kill e own broda. Wa mek Cain kill e broda? Cause e beena do dem ting wa ebil, an e broda beena do dem ting wa right een God eye.
So me bredren, mus dohn wonda ef de people ob de wol hate oona.
We know we done cross oba fom det eenta life. We know dat, cause we lob de bredren. Ebrybody wa ain lob e broda, dat one still dead.
Ebrybody wa da hate e broda, e like a poson wa da kill. An oona know dey ain nobody wa da kill wa got de ebalastin life.
Now den, dis mek we ondastan wa lob mean: Christ done gii e life fa we sake. Same fashion, we too oughta gii we life fa sake ob we bredren.
Bot wen somebody hab plenty ting bot e ain hab no pity pon e broda dat e see ain got wa e need, dat rich man ain got none ob God lob een e haat!
Me chullun, we mus dohn show we lob jes by de way we da taak, by wa we say. We haffa do dem ting wa da show dat we lob fa true.
We Kin Be Full op wid Courage Wen We Come Fo God
So den, dis wa gwine mek we know we blongst ta de trute an we ain gwine warry een we haat wen we come fo God.
Ef we haat jedge we, say we ain do right, we know God great mo den we haat, an e know all ting.
Me deah fren dem, ef we haat ain condemn we, we full op wid courage wen we come fo God.
An God da gii we wasoneba we aks um fa, cause we keep on da do wa e chaage we fa do an de ting dem wa please um.
Dis wa God chaage we fa do: We fa bleebe pon de name ob e Son Jedus Christ. An we oughta lob one noda, same like Christ chaage we fa do.
Ebrybody wa da do wa God chaage um fa do, dat one da lib een God, an God da lib dey een dat poson haat. We know e da lib een we haat cause ob de Holy Sperit dat e gii we.
